خَارٌّ part. n. of 1. (TA.) ―
-b2- خُرَّارٌ [is a pl. thereof: and] signifies (assumed tropical:) Men coming from one town, or country, or the like, to another; as also ↓ خَرَّارَةٌ : which latter signifies also (assumed tropical:) Men passing along, or away, or by. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
